verdict.rationale: Convex delegates app-user auth to third-party providers it documents integrating with: Clerk, Auth0, and WorkOS AuthKit, which it describes as 'built for B2B apps'. Its native Convex Auth library covers only social providers, one-time email/SMS codes, and passwords. Enterprise SSO and MFA would therefore depend on an external provider, and none of the evidence explicitly mentions MFA, SAML, or OIDC. Missing for 10: explicit MFA enforcement, documented SAML/OIDC enterprise SSO support (native or via a provider), configuration docs for requiring them, and independent corroboration.
